name: UGC AI Copilot API
description:
Centralized OpenAPI contract for Copilot AI modes: Ask, Plan, Review, and Research.

Implements an async polling architecture using request_id-based task tracking.
Includes task lifecycle modeling (pending, processing, completed, failed),
structured review outputs, and standardized response schemas.

Version 1.0.0 – Initial unified contract for Copilot async architecture.
